prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1250; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state the date and time of the accident for the record.
A: I'd rather not guess at the exact time, but it was the afternoon, on a weekday.

Q: Where did the collision happen?
A: On a two-lane road in Baytown, Texas, near an intersection with a gas station on the corner.

Q: Can you describe how the collision occurred?
A: I was driving forward and the other car came across into my lane. We hit nearly head-on, but it was slow. I'd guess we were both moving at maybe ten or fifteen miles per hour.

Q: Did you brake before impact?
A: Yes, I braked hard, but there wasn't much room to stop.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, and the airbags did not deploy.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: I did. I walked around a little, but I felt stiff and sore.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They said I had a neck strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatory medication.

Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms now?
A: Yes. My neck is sore, especially when I turn my head to the left, and I get some stiffness in the morning. Sitting for long periods makes it worse.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries to your neck or upper back?
A: No, nothing that I can recall. I've never had treatment for my neck before.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add?
A: Just that I want to cooperate fully and I'm still working on getting back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
